BETA Close X Card Factory PLC has announced the purchase of 2,007,334 ordinary shares between July 27 and July 31, 2026, with prices ranging from 71.00 pence to 77.00 pence per share. The company's issued ordinary share capital now stands at 341,836,073 shares, with 3,867,640 held in treasury, leaving 337,968,433 shares for shareholder calculations. Disclaimer* Card Factory PLC 03 August 2026 03 August 2026 Card Factory plc (the "Company") Transactions in own shares Card Factory plc, the UK's leading specialist retailer of greeting cards, gifts and celebration essentials, announces that it purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 1 pence each in the capital of the Company ('Ordinary Shares') through UBS AG London Branch. The Ordinary Shares purchased will be cancelled. Date of purchase: 27 July 2026 28 July 2026 29 July 2026 30 July 2026 31 July 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 273,670 416,000 430,000 534,000 350,014 Highest price paid per share (pence per share): 72.00 73.30 75.50 77.00 76.50 Lowest price paid per share (pence per share): 71.00 71.60 73.90 75.60 75.00 Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share): 71.7423 72.8576 75.0690 76.6739 75.6117 The Company notifies the market that at the date of this announcement the Company's issued ordinary share capital comprises 341,836,073 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 1p each ("Ordinary Shares") with each share carrying one vote. In aggregate, 3,867,640 Ordinary Shares are held in treasury. The number of 337,968,433 ordinary shares may be used by shareholders in the Company as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change in their interest in, the ordinary share capital of the Company under the FCA's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. This disclosure is made pursuant to paragraph 9.6.6(R) of the Listing Rules. The table below contains detailed information about the purchases made as part of the Share repurchase programme.
